reasoning: The pipeline's rule is that a shown result closes the work and the person's own eye is never the gate on an ordinary delivery. A row whose definition of done names his eye is only describing one of the three cases rule 12/27 reserve for him — a taste call, a trade-off no artifact settles, or a change to the definition of correct still an open fork. This is none of those: the document states no part of the result is a matter of preference, and the page shows what the plan holds and nothing else. It is an ordinary buildable result that a command, a test and a plain read already confirm was delivered — render-board.sh regenerates board.html from PLAN.md, every declared row appears under its own state, tests/test_board_matches_the_canon.py passes against the generated page, and the rendered surface was opened and read, which satisfies the receipt's --surface requirement for a done naming a page. So the acceptance receipt can be written by a verifier who is not the row's holder and close can read it; the pipeline closes the checkpoint and the row in the same step, shows the result, and continues without waiting for his attention. If he disagrees after looking, that disagreement is a new fact and its own task; the closed row stays closed.
